session.description: The number of the session whose runtime wrote the record, from 1: the session of its dev.qory.session.started.

line.description: The number of the line of the session's standard output the record was read from, from 1, counting every line, whether it is a JSON object or not. The session sets it on an event of the output source; an event of a hook has none.

summary.description: One member of input, the one at the path the descriptor's tools.summary gives for this tool, copied when it is a string: the session copies it and computes nothing. The 1 KiB limit applies to each summary value, not to the tools.summary table: the session cuts each summary at 1 KiB (1024 bytes) of UTF-8, at a character boundary. No member marks a cut summary. Absent when tools.summary does not list the tool or input has no string at that path.

response.description: What the tool returned; its shape is the tool's.

agent_id.description: The subagent this happened in, when it did not happen in the main conversation.

agent_type.description: The subagent's type, or the agent the session was started as.
